technical.summary: IBM shows long-term bullish structure with price above key moving averages, but overbought conditions (RSI 14, Stochastic, Williams %R) combined with weak intermediate trend (EMA 20/50) and bearish stochastic cross create pullback risk; moderate entry quality with elevated reversal probability.

fundamental.summary: IBM shows no actionable smart money signals with zero insider activity, no institutional positioning data, absent government contract wins, no lobbying activity, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 28 days adds timing risk.

sentiment.summary: Mixed signals: modest congressional buying (2 purchases vs 1 sale, small amounts) lacks conviction; market fear (42/100) presents contrarian opportunity but insufficient news data and neutral AAII sentiment prevent strong directional conviction.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: VIX at crisis levels (407), flat yield curve signals recession risk, strong USD pressures multinational earnings, with earnings event in 28 days adding execution risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Price above 200-EMA with supertrend bullish and EMA 50/200 bullish cross provides long-term structural support for swing entry near support level 109.21.
debate.key_bear_argument: Overbought conditions (RSI, Stochastic, Williams %R) combined with bearish stochastic cross, weak intermediate trend (EMA 20/50 not bullish), crisis-level VIX, flat yield curve recession signal, and earnings risk in 28 days create high reversal probability with unfavorable macro environment.

decision.entry_rationale: Price at support (109.21) with long-term bullish structure (200-EMA, supertrend) offers technical entry point, but overbought conditions and weak intermediate trend create immediate pullback risk that outweighs entry quality.
decision.primary_risk: Crisis-level VIX (407), flat yield curve recession signal, and earnings event in 28 days create macro headwinds that could trigger sharp reversal from overbought technicals; bearish stochastic cross signals momentum exhaustion.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bear case dominance
decision.portfolio_note: Existing IBM position plus 58 open IT sector positions (17.8% of portfolio) create concentration risk; high sector volatility and zero smart money conviction further reduce conviction for additional exposure.
